Summary: Righteousness is right standing before God and right living before people - two sides of one word in Scripture. No one achieves the first by the second: God credits Christ's righteousness to believers by faith, and that gift then produces a life that increasingly does what is right. The prophets and apostles agree: righteousness is both a status received and a calling pursued, and a church that separates them has misunderstood both.
KeyPassages: Genesis 15:6; Psalm 1:1-6; Isaiah 61:10; Romans 3:21-26; Romans 5:17; Philippians 3:7-9
